Nitya Cloudtech is Hiring!!

Position: Full Stack AI Developer

We are looking for a passionate Full Stack AI Developer who is interested in building modern, AI-powered web applications and SaaS products.

Key Skills Required:

* Frontend: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
* Backend: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs
* AI/LLM: OpenAI API, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLM Integration
* Database: PostgreSQL, SQL
* AI concepts: RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases
* Cloud & Deployment: Azure, Docker, Git, CI/CD

Responsibilities:

* Develop end-to-end AI-powered web applications.
* Integrate LLMs and AI APIs into applications.
* Build scalable backend services and responsive frontend interfaces.
* Work on database design, API development and cloud deployment.
* Develop innovative AI-based SaaS solutions.

Experience: 0–2 Years (Freshers with strong practical skills are welcome)

What We Are Looking For:

* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Hands-on project experience in Full Stack or AI development.
* Passion for building real-world AI products.
* Ability to learn and work independently.

📩 Interested candidates: Share your resume and GitHub/portfolio via DM.
